scope.alpha_contract: Flag int32 0/1 captured in plan. Disabled: host FP32 scalar alpha; enabled: Matmul alpha argument is borrowed device-accessible FP32 vector[M], indexed by logical output row, shared across batches. GPU loads vector; host never dereferences it.
scope.beta_contract: Scalar host FP32 beta retained. Beta-vector getter returns0; disabling succeeds; enabling returns NOT_SUPPORTED; invalid flags/sizes rejected. Pinned upstream enum exists but implementation/client vector contract absent.
scope.coverage: sparse A/B, row/column orders and all transposes, f32/f16/bf16, strip/TILE/partial tiles, zero-stride input masks, same-type/FP32 row bias, six activations, signed zero/negative/positive alpha rows, all-zero vector with NaN-poisoned operands, zero-beta poisoned C, exact in-place C/D, source flag mutation after plan creation, immutable vector/pack/D guards and exact/partial D-vector overlap/alignment rejection
scope.reference_boundary: Dense-double reference honors zero-alpha/zero-beta skip semantics for unused terms, including sign-of-zero; bitwise linear/padding checks and existing nonlinear tolerances unchanged.
